channel.description: Latest articles from The Logical Indian (thelogicalindian.com)

item.title: Rajasthan: Class 8 Girl Allegedly Gang-Raped by 3 Youths After Being Drugged Near Exam Centre in Bundi
item.description: Three youths allegedly drugged a Class 8 girl with spiked water near her school in Bundi, Rajasthan, and gang-raped her as she made her way home after sitting a board examination.

item.title: L&T Finance’s Apurva Rathod on Digital Sakhi and the Future of Inclusive Finance
item.description: Ms. Apurva Rathod - Company Secretary and Chief Sustainability Officer, L&T Finance shares how L&T Finance integrates governance-backed sustainability and initiatives like Digital Sakhi to drive long-term financial inclusion for rural women.

item.title: Lumpsum Calculator: How Much Return Can ₹1,00,000 Generate Over 15 Years?
item.description: A practical guide to understanding how a lumpsum calculator helps investors project long-term wealth growth across different return scenarios.

item.title: First Indian Casualty in US-Iran Conflict; 4 Injured as 2 Oil Tankers Hit Near Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Indian crew member killed, 15 rescued after Hormuz tanker strikes heighten energy fears.

item.title: From Tehran to Lucknow: Khamenei’s Death Sparks 40-Day Mourning and Global Tensions
item.description: Iran mourns Khamenei for 40 days after his death in US-Israel strikes, as protests and restraint appeals spread.

item.title: What Happened in Last 48 Hours: Over 1,000 Targets Struck, 3 US Troops Killed as US-Iran War Spirals Into Regional Crisis
item.description: US-Israeli airstrikes and Iranian retaliation mark deadliest escalation in years, destabilising Gulf region.

item.title: India is Preparing For Another War? Pakistan President Issues Stark Warning, Seeks Urgent Diplomatic Talks
item.description: Pakistan’s President urges diplomatic engagement over military escalation, warning that renewed hostility could destabilise South Asia.

item.title: US Embassy in Saudi Arabia Hit by Drones; Trump Warns Retaliation Is Coming ‘Very Soon’
item.description: Two drones struck the US Embassy compound in Riyadh’s Diplomatic Quarter, causing minor damage but no casualties, as Saudi air defences intercepted additional UAVs amid rising regional tensions.

item.title: From Traffic Cameras to 60-Second Airstrikes: The Years-Long Operation That Killed Ali Khamenei and Sparked a Gulf War
item.description: Investigation reveals years-long Israeli cyber-surveillance enabled strike on Iran’s leader, triggering retaliation, casualties and disruption.

item.title: Trump Defends Past Strikes, US and Israel Escalate Iran Offensive Targeting Missiles, Navy, Nuclear Sites
item.description: The US and Israel have intensified strikes on Iran, aiming to dismantle nuclear, missile, and naval capabilities amid rising regional tensions.
